description: Hard negatives: near-topic evidence from other incidents, meetings and documents (other services, other retry policies, an older onboarding plan). Mixed into the evaluation corpus so retrieval has to discriminate instead of returning half the corpus.

nodes.transcript: Search latency has been creeping up since the index rebuild last week.
Here is the cache warming plan we agreed on.

nodes.transcript: The email worker now retries failed sends three times with a fixed delay.
Copy for the onboarding welcome emails is ready for review.
Payments reconciliation job finished without errors last night.

nodes.content: Summary: search p95 latency rose from 180ms to 900ms after the nightly index rebuild overlapped with peak traffic.
Root cause: the rebuild saturated the primary database; read traffic had no replica to fall back to.
Remediation: add two read replicas, move the rebuild off-peak, and retry search reads with a fixed delay of 100ms, max_retries=3.
nodes.visual_summary: Page 3 with a table of remediation owners and dates.
A dashboard screenshot of Kafka consumer lag for the orders topic: a tall spike during the batch import, then recovery to near zero after adding a consumer.

nodes.content: Ticket #3810: Customer cannot log in after password reset; reset link expired immediately.

Survey response #91: Checkout page feels cluttered on mobile.
Proposal (v1): request location, notifications and contacts together on a single screen to keep onboarding short.
